title: Automatic reminders say on but the owner cannot see who will actually get them
what: The automatic reminders page shows each reminder as on or off and says members with the app get them. It never shows, per member or as a count, who will get a given reminder and who will not (no app, app not linked, notifications off, turned off in their app, no date of birth for the birthday wish). Members who silently get nothing are invisible.
expected: Each reminder shows how many members it really reaches and a list of who will not get it and why.
fix_line: Show a reach line per reminder with the reason list

title: No record that an automatic reminder ever went to a member
what: The reminders are set and fired by each member's phone. Nothing reports back, so the owner (or HQ) has no record that a plan-ends or birthday reminder went, to whom, when, or why it did not.
expected: A log the owner can open: which reminder went to which member on which day, and the reason when one was skipped.
fix_line: Have the phone report each reminder it fires or skips, and show it on the member page

title: The birthday wish depends on a date of birth the reminder page never flags as missing
what: The birthday reminder goes only to members whose date of birth is on their member page. The reminder page does not say how many members have no date of birth, so the switch can be on while most members never get it. Real counts on the test gym were not taken (this step had no database access).
expected: The birthday row says how many members have no date of birth and links to fill them in.
fix_line: Add a missing-birthday count with a link to fix

title: Save on automatic reminders is greyed out with no words saying it is already saved
what: When nothing has changed, the Save button is greyed out. The page does not say the current choices are already saved; it only names who changed them last.
expected: Next to a greyed Save, a short line: all changes saved.
fix_line: Show an already-saved line next to the greyed button

title: The daily alert summary push counts updates the owner already handled
what: The panel hides alerts that were already handled (conversation marked done, request approved) but works this out only inside the browser. The server's daily summary push counts every alert not yet pushed, so it can say 5 new updates from your members when the owner has already dealt with all five.
expected: The summary push counts only alerts that still need someone, the same as the bell and Today.
how_often: every time an alert is handled before the summary hour
fix_line: Keep the handled mark on the server and let the summary skip handled alerts

title: An info alert seen on one computer still waits on every other computer and person
what: Info alerts (paid online, member joined, report sent) leave Today once seen, but that seen mark lives only in that browser. The same owner on the phone, or the front desk, still sees them as new.
expected: Seen on one device is seen for that person everywhere.
how_often: every time more than one device is used
fix_line: Store the seen mark on the server per person

title: An alert push is marked sent before anyone knows it arrived
what: The server marks an alert as sent when the summary is claimed, before the push is delivered. If the push company fails (other than an address that is gone), nothing records it and the owner cannot see that the alert never reached their phone.
expected: Each push records delivered or failed per browser, and the alert settings show the last delivery.
fix_line: Record the push result per browser and show the last good delivery

title: Gym news says Sent to N members with no way to see who received or read it
what: After an in-app message the panel says it was sent to N members in the app. There is no record per member of whether the message arrived or was opened, and members with notifications off are counted the same.
expected: The sent message shows how many saw it, and who did not.
fix_line: Record opens per member and show a seen count on the sent message

title: In the app counts members whose app is linked, not those who can be reached
what: A member counts as in the app if their record has an app link or their number matches an app user. It does not check whether that phone still has the app or allows notifications, so the in-app count overstates who will see the message.
expected: The count separates members who can be notified from those who are linked but silent.
fix_line: Keep a notifications-allowed flag per app member and count that

title: A mobile number written with Hindi digits or a 0091 prefix is not matched
what: The number cleaner keeps only English digits and strips only +91 or a leading 0. A number typed with Devanagari digits or with a 0091 prefix becomes no number, so the member is shown as not in the app.
expected: Any common way of writing an Indian mobile number is matched.
fix_line: Turn other-script digits into English digits and strip 0091

title: A new staff member sees new-feature dots on things that existed before they joined
what: The new-feature dots are hidden for features older than the gym's start date, but not older than the person. A desk person added months later, or anyone on a new computer, sees dots on things that are not new to the gym.
expected: Dots count from the later of the gym's start and the person's first sign-in.
fix_line: Use the person's own start date for the dots

title: AI ideas on Today ask the owner to send reminders the app already sends automatically
what: The Today for you ideas suggest writing birthday wishes, renewal reminders for plans ending this week and we-miss-you messages. They never read the automatic reminder switches, so with plan-ends-soon and birthday on (the default) the owner is nudged to send a second message to the same members on the same day.
expected: An idea for a reminder that already goes automatically is left out, or says it already goes and offers only the members it cannot reach.
how_often: every day there is a birthday or a plan ending
fix_line: Let the ideas read the automatic reminder switches

title: AI idea 'Not seen for 10+ days' counts members who joined days ago and have not come yet
what: The away count takes every member with a running plan and no visit ever as not seen for 10+ days. A member who joined today or three days ago, or whose plan starts this week, is counted and named as not seen for 10 days. The Visits page's Losing the habit list gives newcomers a settling-in grace, so the two counts differ. The admin What's new (in folder c01) says someone who joined today is no longer counted; the code in this folder still counts them.
expected: A member with no visit counts as away only when their join or plan start is at least 10 days ago, matching Losing the habit.
how_often: every new member in their first 10 days
fix_line: Measure no-visit members from their join or plan start day

title: WhatsApp done marks live in one browser, so a second person sends the same reminder again
what: When the owner works through a WhatsApp list (from Messages or from the AI), who was already messaged is kept only in that browser. The desk on another computer, or the owner on the phone, sees the full list again and can message the same members twice. Nothing on the server records who got a WhatsApp.
expected: Who was messaged is kept on the server and every device and person sees the same done marks.
how_often: every time two devices or people send
fix_line: Save the done marks on the server per message

title: No record of which members got a WhatsApp message from the panel
what: Messages sent through the WhatsApp list leave no record the owner can open later (who, when, which words). Clearing the browser or using another device loses even the local list.
expected: A sent log per message: members messaged on WhatsApp, with the day.
fix_line: Write each WhatsApp send to a server log shown on the message

title: AI message result can say 'Sent to 0 in the app'
what: When none of the chosen members have the app, the assistant still reports Sent to 0 in the app before the WhatsApp line, which reads as a failure.
expected: Say only that the members are ready on WhatsApp when nobody is in the app.
how_often: whenever a group has no app members
fix_line: Drop the in-app part when the count is zero

title: A task where one step worked and a later step failed gives back all the credits
what: The assistant spends credits for the whole task, runs the steps in order, and on the first failure refunds the whole task, even when an earlier step (a member added, a message sent) already went through.
expected: Only the credits for steps that did not happen come back.
fix_line: Refund only the failed and skipped steps

title: Automatic reminders promise members get them, but iPhone members get no app notifications at all
what: The owner's reminder page says members with the MettleUp app get the reminders on their phone. The member app's own notes say every notification of the app is still off on iPhone, so iPhone members silently get no plan-ends, birthday or welcome reminder, and the owner is never told.
expected: Either iPhone gets the reminders, or the owner's page says Android only and counts the iPhone members who will not get them.
how_often: cannot be proven in the cloud, needs a real-phone check (iPhone: does any reminder or gym notice arrive)
fix_line: Say Android only on the owner's page until iPhone notifications ship

title: An iPhone member who gets no rest alert is never told why
what: The rest alert status row (blocked, silent, may be late, with a tap to fix) only runs on Android. On iPhone it shows nothing, so a member whose rest timer never alerts sees no reason and no fix.
expected: On iPhone the row says whether rest alerts work there and what to do.
how_often: cannot be proven in the cloud, needs a real-phone check (iPhone: end a rest timer with the app in the background)
fix_line: Show an iPhone status line for rest alerts

title: Rest alerts and gym pop-ups depend on phone maker sound, banner and battery rules
what: Whether a rest alert or a gym pop-up reaches the member depends on the phone maker's own rules (channel importance, battery saver, do not disturb) and on a paired watch. The app reads the channel setting only to attach it to feedback; whether the alert really arrives on time cannot be shown from code.
expected: Checked on real phones from the main makers and a paired watch: alert sound, banner and timing with the screen off.
how_often: cannot be proven in the cloud, needs a real-phone check (Xiaomi, Samsung, Vivo: battery saver on, screen off, watch paired; look at sound, banner and delay)
fix_line: Run the real-phone check and add any maker fix steps to the status row

title: The help reply pop-up never comes when notifications are off, with no hint
what: When the MettleUp team answers a member's question, the phone shows a pop-up only if notifications are already allowed and only on Android. The app never asks or says the answer will only show as a dot inside the app.
expected: After sending a question, a member with notifications off is told the answer will appear in Help and feedback.
fix_line: Add one line after sending: the reply will show in Help and feedback
